text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Air Shakur...
However...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "Just leave it around there. It's not like anything important is written on it anyway."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Anyone sending one to me has gotta be a total weirdo.
Not like they expect me to read it in the first place.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hey, if you're a pro, act like one.
Don't go bringing personal feelings into this.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Whatever I think of my fans,
that's my own damn business.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Instead, I don't give a damn what the opponent thinks... That makes us totally equal, doesn't it?

"That might be so.
If that's the case, however—"
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll keep the letters safe.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Huuuh?
I told ya, I don't need your meddling—
choice_data_list: As your trainer, we're equals, right?
As your Trainer, we're equals, right?

text_block_list.text:
After finishing training, I immediately went to transfer the fan letters into a storage box.
Just then—

A single postcard fell to the floor,
and its contents unintentionally caught my eye.
Written there was...
"'When I was struggling with work, seeing you run with everything you had without giving up gave me courage. That's why... I won't tell you to do your best.'"

"‘There are people out there cheering for you.
I sent this letter because I wanted you to know that.
I'm rooting for you.’"

A few days later, another fan letter arrived.
Air Shakur still made no move to open it, however...
choice_data_list: Let's do our best in today's training too.

text_block_list.text:
"...It might not be what society considers a normal
fan relationship. But there is undeniably a bond there."

With that thought in mind,
I felt even more motivated for training!
